name: Mirror Android Phone Control
summary:
Mirror Android Phone Control lets you view and control your Android phone directly inside Meta Quest.

Connect your Android phone and Quest headset over the same Wi-Fi network, then access your phone screen without removing your headset.

You can interact with your phone using Quest controllers or hand tracking, making it easy to use Android apps while staying in VR or mixed reality.

Key features include:

Mirror your Android phone screen in real time
Control your phone from Meta Quest
Tap, swipe, scroll,
